answer: Last spring the tiler re-roofed the chapel, and the rain has not found a way in since. Proof of tiler roof via tile overlap record was his proof: a roof the tiler lays only after 22 tiles overlap true, each tile hung on the batten. The anchor was the chapel itself, dry through every storm. The wander was the warm light under the new roof. The zenith was the gutter the tiles feed. To fake that roof a man must hang 22 tiles, overlap each one true, and climb the ladder 22 times, a day of height work for tiles that still slip.
